objects.name: Apple security advisory (AV26-641)
objects.description: Serial number: AV26-641 Date: June 29, 2026 On June 29, 2026, Apple published security advisories to address vulnerabilities in the following products: iOS and iPadOS – versions prior to 26.5.2 macOS Tahoe – versions prior to 26.5.2 The Cyber Centre encourages users and administrators to review the provided web links and apply the necessary updates. About the security content of iOS 26.5.2 and iPadOS 26.5.2 About the security content of macOS Tahoe 26.5.2 Apple security releases
